data.name: Kawsar
data.gender_notes: Kawsar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kawsar means a lush and beautiful garden in Paradise, as described in the Quran. It symbolizes a life of peace and tranquility. The name Kawsar carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kawsar usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kawsar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Kawsar
in_english.meaning: Paradise, abundance, plentiful, a river in Paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Kawsar is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning Paradise, abundance, plentiful. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Kawsar, as a river in Paradise bestowed by Allah to Prophet Muhammad. The name signifies divine blessings, prosperity, and spiritual richness. In Islamic tradition, Kawsar symbolizes the ultimate reward for believers, reflecting themes of generosity, mercy, and eternal life.
